topicRecords.summary:
Retain four common cores: ethical-norm recognition, duties/prohibitions, disclosure/divestment orientation and consequence recognition. Grouped headings preserve distinct rules; list size alone does not justify splitting. Both CSE levels can share these English foundations, but finer provision selection, case forms and required depth remain unknown. Official broad Code inclusion differs from weak reviewer finer choices and curriculum-inferred corruption outcomes. No excess content is established by organizer silence.

Current examples support short rule retrieval and two norm classifications. Gift conditions, other continuing post-employment bans, broader statutory subclauses, SALN preparation/exemptions/use restrictions, conflict determination, review/compliance and corruption effects are locally partial or absent. Counts and names do not establish whole-Code teaching. SALN entry example gives only an interval despite a dated prompt. Current penalties examples supply violation/participation/proof, so related duties/disclosure lessons remain optional context. No strictly necessary existing-lesson prerequisite or answer-critical figure dependency was found.

Encountered legal summaries match the bounded statutory/IRR rules recorded in the ledger, with source-specific qualifications. Code reply timing is not a universal government service-processing deadline. Statutory SALN periods/routing do not establish complete current digital filing or repository access procedure. The current CSC update confirms procedural changes; full reconciliation remains outside this Level3 read. No source or content correction was performed. Practice is deferred, runtime unknown, and fresh independent review is required.

topicRecords.summary:
Retain four focused cores: article location, safeguard orientation, impeachment-list recognition and CSC qualifications. No strict existing-lesson prerequisite or answer-critical figure dependency was found. Current examples supply the lists and rules they use; related deeper teaching remains optional. Article titles, named grounds and one-line safeguards do not establish substantive application coverage. State principles, branch powers, citizenship/suffrage rules, rights analysis/remedies and broader civic/history/geography/current-event skills are locally absent or thin as individually recorded. These are preparation findings, not proof of global absence or universal exam requirements.

Both 2026 CSE-PPT levels officially name Constitution under General Information in English. PUPCET civic connections and broader human-rights outcomes remain curriculum-inferred; finer reviewer choices remain weak. Fine legal depth, future-cycle continuity and item forms are unknown. English teaching exists; no Filipino teaching/example was encountered in these four bodies, without implying a Filipino requirement for CSE General Information. Practice remains deferred and runtime unknown.

One concrete scenario gap needs later clarification: the CSC example states last-year candidacy but assumes the immediately preceding election. Bail summary omits before-conviction scope. Other acknowledged exceptions and impeachment procedure are not developed. No content correction or Level 4 legal sweep was performed.

Committee is included among collectives permitting singular/plural agreement by unit/individual construal. Purdue favors singular committee in its American-oriented guide. Approved remains a natural American completed-event answer, but approve can be a finite present plural-agreement reading in accepted English. The future instruction should specify convention/context or use a noncollective singular subject rather than excluding every alternative by grammar. This is an encountered source concern, not a full correctness or question-standards review.

topicRecords.summary:
Retain shareable meaning-in-context, sense-first comparison and genuine-word-part principles once. The accepted CSE 2026 PPT records explicitly name word meaning in English and Filipino and English Clerical spelling for Subprofessional. UPCAT confirms broad bilingual Language Proficiency; USTET confirms an English discipline without exact item-language rules. DOST English vocabulary is historical 2026, with 2027 continuity unknown. Other exam fine vocabulary candidates remain curriculum/weak/current-scope uncertain. Specialized word lists, language allocations and tested difficulty remain unknown; no roster or example count proves whole-lesson coverage.

- Actual bilingual evidence is partial: five bodies contain Filipino target-language examples or phrases, but explanations mainly use English. Spelling explains a Filipino orthography reference case through English. This records teaching/example presence, not a Level4 language/voice pass or complete Filipino instruction. English-only Clerical spelling does not establish the Filipino addition as required CSE spelling scope.
- Split candidate: Idioms in Context versus Figurative Interpretation. Conventional phrase meaning and rhetorical-device/effect analysis use distinct evidence and preparation facets. Preserve the common context strategy once; add developed effects/transfer teaching to the figurative strand. Costs: approved new identities/routing, moved examples/traps/terminology, sources and later practice alignment. Unknown exam depth does not justify removing either strand (current body lines12-129,L01/L19 structural).
- Retain the other five current units as coherent goals. Word-part work needs complex Filipino segmentation rather than a supplied root answer (root body lines60-84); spelling needs explicit stress/suffix derivation; connotation/register/collocation need worked distinctions beyond names. Filipino affix contributions and several tayutay applications are missing or thin. No arbitrary word-list or example minimum is used.
- Vocabulary sentence-context examples do not establish longer-passage transfer. A narrow full read verifies shared definition/example/contrast teaching in the existing passage source, plus actual multi-sentence application. Reuse that common core while preserving separate application blocks; title similarity alone does not justify a merger. Both-source evidence and the foundation read hash are in the appendix. No coverage verdict for the other topic is made.
- Analogy completion is locally absent from these six bodies. Synonym/antonym contrasts, figurative comparisons and affix clues are not relation-transfer procedures. The existing Reasoning analogy lesson remains a lead reconciliation reference, not a global absence inference.
- All six current consumers define their target concepts or supply their deciding method/meaning. Related grammar, morphology and passage teaching are optional preparation; no indispensable absent idea with a necessary existing target was established. Six explicit no-edge records are saved, with lesson-specific reasoning. Future split/expanded teaching creates no current prerequisite.
- No load-bearing figure dependency was encountered: deciding sentences, word forms, meanings and conditions are textual. Runtime remains unknown; question/practice, illustration assessment and all Levels 4/5 work remain deferred.
- Bounded source ledger preserves verified English senses, partial Filipino support and unresolved language claims. The KWF guide preserves u in cuento-to-kuwento; the lesson's assertion that the orthography explicitly accepts both kwento/kuwento is not confirmed by located normative text. A KWF lecture slide listing forms is not an acceptance rule. No global claim that kwento is always wrong follows. Other unverified Filipino parsing/lexical/literary claims remain qualified, not accepted from weak reviewer evidence.

Source scope: [accepted requirement packets](../requirements/), [CSE scope](../overlap/cse-scope.md), [CET/scholarship scope](../overlap/cet-scholarship-scope.md#language-and-reading). Exact requirement IDs carry source/cycle/cohort confidence. Primary encountered language references include [KWF dictionary/orthography guide](https://www.kwfdiksiyonaryo.ph/gabay.php), [KWF Manwal section9.1](https://kwfwikaatkultura.ph/wp-content/uploads/2024/05/Manwal-sa-Masinop-na-Pagsulat.pdf), [DepEd Filipino5 teaching material](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/create/download/1751) and publisher dictionary entries linked in the ledger. Those checks are bounded claims, not a complete correctness or new exam-source pass.

topicRecords.summary:
Teach shared algebra once, preserving separate local facets. UPCAT/USTET officially name Mathematics; their finer depth is unpublished in the accepted records. DOST names Algebra in the historical 2026 primer, with 2027 continuity unknown. Most CET/SM finer methods are curriculum or weak preparation candidates, with SHS track/cohort/completion limits. CSE 2026 PPT officially names English word problems; additional algebra is largely weak reviewer preparation. No single roster establishes equal whole-lesson scope, current item language, runtime availability or full exam coverage. Practice and later standards remain deferred.

- Split candidates: exponent manipulation versus logarithm teaching; one-variable linear solving versus coordinate line/half-plane reasoning. These separate reusable foundations from different method goals and conditional scope. Costs: approved new identities/routing, moved examples/traps, missing-method additions and later practice review. Evidence: exponents-and-logarithms lines 12-44, 60-157; linear-equations-inequalities lines 12-35, 75-118 (L01/L17/L19 structural use).
- Retain polynomial operations, quadratic solving, simultaneous-equation methods and the six-scenario modeling lesson as coherent shared goals. Thin division/root-search labels need actual teaching before a further split can improve learning. Reorder the function-family overview so necessary meanings precede applications; do not create one unit per family.
- Important local gaps: polynomial division and Rational Root Theorem; general polynomial-factor rational operations, rational equations/inequalities; quadratic/exponential/logarithmic inequalities; explicit variation models and higher-degree polynomial graph interpretation. Monomial power quotients, radical rationalization, motion/work patterns and quadratic vertices are present, so these gaps are deliberately narrower. Other-topic reconciliation remains with the lead.
- Completing the square, formula solving, range derivation, constrained composition/inverse branches and some graph methods have missing or thin worked applications. No arbitrary example minimum is used. Detailed facet evidence occurs once in the appendix.
- Two narrow prerequisite edges are proposed: function-family teaching needs the definition/inverse pairing in Functions and Relations; current line-plotting instructions need coordinate address/axis meanings. Existing repeated procedures, supplied factored expressions, converted percentages and supplied roots do not justify extra edges. Both ends are cited below.
- All owned prompts supply the deciding formulas, pairs, region facts or counts in text. No load-bearing figure dependency was found, including the shaded-region and Venn examples. Markers do not prove runtime display or illustration sufficiency.
- Encountered concerns: single-input verification is insufficient; the power-of-power rule needs precise domain restrictions; generic system graphing must allow nonlinear curves. Universal CET choice-tactic claims remain unverified. Only bounded algebraic checks were performed, with no question-bank/blind-solve or full correctness claim.

Accepted source packets: [UPCAT](../requirements/upcat.md), [DCAT](../requirements/dcat.md), [ACET](../requirements/acet.md), [USTET](../requirements/ustet.md), [PUPCET](../requirements/pupcet.md), [DOST-SEI](../requirements/dost-sei.md), [SM Foundation](../requirements/sm-foundation.md), [CSE Professional](../requirements/cse-professional.md), [CSE Subprofessional](../requirements/cse-subprofessional.md). Requirement IDs carry exact source/page/confidence. Common preparation source: [DepEd Grades 1-10 Mathematics](https://www.deped.gov.ph/wp-content/uploads/2019/01/Math-CG_with-tagged-math-equipment.pdf), Grade 7-10 standards and cited competencies. Conditional SHS source: [General Mathematics listing](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/detail/14511), competencies, and its packet-linked PDF. Historical DOST named domain: [2026 primer](https://science-scholarships.ph/pdf/2026_DOST-SEI_UG_Primer.pdf), p. 13. These links trace accepted evidence; they are not a new external requirement pass.

topicRecords.summary:
DOST's accepted 2026 primer names Calculus (dost-sei-L122), but current2027 continuity and exact methods remain unknown. Its Basic Calculus and Pre-Calculus competencies are conditional STEM-specific preparation (dost-sei-L135/L134), not universal applicant exposure or a published detailed exam blueprint. SM's conic candidate is also STEM-specific (sm-foundation-L096), with current academic scope unresolved. Other exams' calculus inclusion remains unknown or conflicting, not excluded. Readiness, current item language and depth cannot be inferred from the sole-map calculus tags. No complete exam-coverage claim is made.

- Retain the three introductory calculus units. Their concepts/methods serve coherent local goals; missing applications do not constitute developed material that a split would improve. Teach each shared core once and defer a methods/applications split until source-bounded teaching exists. Costs are targeted conceptual/worked additions and later practice review, not automatic new lesson identities.
- Reorder Conic Sections: put the completing-square recipe, vertex formula and feature meanings before applications. Current identification and feature calculations support one comparison unit, not a separate lesson for each curve. Graph construction is thin, distinct from reading formulas/coordinates. Current conic body lines12-190 support this L01/L17/L19 structural recommendation.
- Explicit curriculum gap: no Riemann-sum approximation in Basic Integrals (lines10-142, dost-sei-L135). Signed/total area and larger-degree/infinite/unequal-side limit cases lack complete worked applications. Derivative rate meaning is thin; difference-quotient derivation and broader rate/optimization applications are local preparation gaps whose precise exam depth is unknown. Details occur once in the appendix.
- Conic focus/directrix meaning, complete graph construction and some translated/vertical features are missing or thin. Compound STEM row facets remain separate: nonlinear systems, series, induction and polar conversion are not taught locally here. Inventory leads in Algebra/Arithmetic/Trigonometry/Geometry require lead reconciliation, not global absent verdicts.
- One narrow prerequisite is proposed: conic coordinate positions need the ordered-pair address definition in Coordinate Geometry. Three lessons have explicit no-necessary-existing-prerequisite findings. Local definitions/procedures and optional checking methods do not justify additional strict links; future expanded lessons do not justify current edges.
- All four bodies provide deciding equations, domains, branch conditions and interval limits in text. No current example requires a displayed figure to obtain its answer. This records load-bearing dependence only; placeholder markers establish neither rendered availability nor illustration sufficiency. Runtime remains unknown; practice and Levels4/5 remain deferred.

Accepted source packets: [DOST-SEI](../requirements/dost-sei.md), [SM Foundation](../requirements/sm-foundation.md), and [CET/scholarship overlap](../overlap/cet-scholarship-scope.md#mathematics-foundations-and-extensions). Historical organizer source: [2026 primer](https://science-scholarships.ph/pdf/2026_DOST-SEI_UG_Primer.pdf), p13. Conditional curriculum sources: [Basic Calculus](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/detail/14400) and [Pre-Calculus](https://lrmds.deped.gov.ph/detail/14427), competency listings. These trace already accepted evidence, without a new external scope pass.

topicRecords.summary:
Teach shared interpretation principles once, preserving distinct genre applications and source/language limits. UPCAT confirms broad English/Filipino Reading Comprehension; current genre/depth details are curriculum or weak preparation. CSE Subprofessional Verbal is bilingual broadly, while Professional Analytical data interpretation is English and supports only the quantitative chart connection. USTET confirms English discipline, not exact item-language/fine genre scope. DOST's Language/Literature evidence is historical2026 with current2027 continuity unknown. Other exam roster/depth/language and school-cohort/completion limits remain as accepted. Counts/names never establish full coverage.

- All five bodies teach and demonstrate through English text. General strategies can transfer, but no Filipino poem, story, informational passage, speech or visual/text application is supplied locally. This is a Text Types finding, not global Filipino absence, exam-language exclusion or a Level4 voice judgment.
- Retain prose-genre comparison, poetry, narrative and speech reading as coherent current goals. The named methods do not justify one lesson per genre, device or narrative element. Many examples are short fragments/synopses, so they demonstrate recognition or qualified inference rather than sustained selection analysis. Whole-text theme, narration, argument/evidence evaluation and several sound/form/pragmatic applications remain thin or missing. Detailed evidence occurs once in JSON.
- Useful split/reconciliation candidate: sequential/symbolic comic-cartoon interpretation versus numerical chart encoding/calculation. The methods and source scopes differ. Visual Media lines31-33,57-70 share unit/category/data-reading strategy with existing Tables and Charts lines12-18,39-54; that source does not teach the current bar-axis distinction. Preserve that distinct addition while reconciling the quantitative route, rather than creating a duplicate chart lesson. Costs: approved scope/routing changes, moved examples/traps, sources and later practice alignment. No illustration production decision.
- Reading interpretation differs from writing production. The prose body does not teach composing a persuasive argument, coherent narrative or critical/academic review, despite ACET conditional curricular writing leads and weak essay reports. Speech recognition does not establish composition, delivery, listening or a spoken exam. Claim taxonomy has partial factual/evaluative/policy instances but no developed three-way procedure. Text-development modes and cohesion/coherence are separate facets with precise local limits, not gaps inferred solely from missing names.
- Other local gaps include Filipino genre application, map/table transfer in Visual Media, complete poetic/narrative excerpt analysis, and communication breakdown/repair. Existing Comprehension, Language and Data units remain lead-owned reconciliation; no corpus-wide absence inferred.
- Five explicit no-necessary-existing-prerequisite records are saved. Each consumer defines the concepts used or supplies deciding evidence. Related deeper devices, rhetoric, genre or data teaching is optional. Future fuller examples or a split do not create a current strict edge.
- No answer-critical figure dependency was found: Visual Media supplies each comic sequence/action/expression, cartoon relation/labels, chart values and baseline in text. Plot/rhetoric diagram concepts are also explained textually. This does not demonstrate actual displayed-media decoding, rendered availability or illustration sufficiency. Those remain unknown/deferred, with no illustration need/quality/count/production assessment.
- Eight bounded source-ledger entries preserve verified definitions/calculations and specific remaining limits. ONS confirms zero-baseline bar magnitudes versus potentially cropped positional line charts; the existing citation token remains untraceable. Selected rhetoric/poetic definitions and character complexity are sourced. Exact genre conventions and broader literary/narrative interpretations are not presented as a full correctness pass. Numeric event/sales snippets are illustrative-looking givens, not verified real-world reports.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Constant-density hydrostatic P=P0+rho gh; same static connected liquid/equal atmospheric boundary gives equal free-surface levels.
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax College Physics2e, Variation of Pressure with Depth
sourceLedger.page: 11.4 equations11.17 and total surface-plus-fluid pressure discussion
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Opened publisher section. It derives fluid-weight pressure from depth and density, treats small density variation appropriately, and adds atmospheric surface pressure. Equal-level statement follows static same-fluid/equal-boundary-pressure comparison; capillary/unequal-pressure exceptions stay explicit. No unconditional all-vessel claim.

sourceLedger.originalContent: A1v1=A2v2; higher speed/lower pressure at equal height along ideal steady streamline.
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax University Physics1, Fluid Dynamics and Bernoulli Equation
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Publisher section states incompressible/no-viscous-force along-streamline energy relation. Continuity belongs to steady incompressible flow/one path. Named pressure-speed shortcut is conditional, not a universal flow law. No fluid numerical-output or pump-loss calculation certified. Continuity source URL: https://openstax.org/books/university-physics-volume-1/pages/14-5-fluid-dynamics, equation14.14.

sourceLedger.issue: Encountered direction, tooth ratio and same-shaft rules at12-33
sourceLedger.originalContent: External meshes reverse, gear speeds inversely follow compatible tooth counts; internal contact may preserve direction and rigid same-shaft gears share velocity.
sourceLedger.disposition: CONFIRMED for stated ordinary fixed-axis connections
sourceLedger.source: Carnegie Mellon Introduction to Mechanisms, Chapters7 and2
sourceLedger.page: 7.6 Ordinary Gear Trains; Chapter2 same-shaft example
sourceLedger.verificationNote: University source states inverse tooth ratio, direction sign from external-mesh count, and no reversal for internal contact in ordinary trains. Chapter2 (https://www.cs.cmu.edu/~rapidproto/mechanisms/chpt2.html) explains keyed gears share speed. It warns broader spatial/planetary arrangements need other analysis. This verifies model conventions, not an exam-frequency claim.

sourceLedger.issue: Encountered pulley support and lever-moment-arm methods at18-40
sourceLedger.originalContent: Ideal supporting rope-segment count gives force gain; lever force ratio depends on perpendicular moment arms.
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax College Physics2e, Simple Machines
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Publisher explains perpendicular input/output lever arms and frictionless tension multiples from cables supporting a load. This supports count-supports rather than count-pulleys and the current perpendicular lever cases. Unfamiliar routing derivation/angled examples remain teaching gaps.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Hooke's law is described as applying within elastic limit/range.
sourceLedger.disposition: QUALIFY: elastic reversibility and linear proportionality differ
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax University Physics1, Elasticity and Plasticity
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Opened publisher section explicitly distinguishes proportional behavior from elastic return: deformation can remain reversible beyond the proportional limit while becoming nonlinear. Later content should say linear/Hooke-law range rather than equating all elasticity with linearity. Worked examples already assume ideal/linear/Hooke-law range, so this does not create a richer Physics prerequisite.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Restoring spring force versus displacement from equilibrium; hanging extension mg/k.
sourceLedger.disposition: QUALIFY natural/unloaded versus loaded equilibrium origin
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax College Physics2e, Elasticity Stress and Strain
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Publisher describes change in length/deformation for Hooke force. The current hanging extension should reference the spring's unstretched length; a loaded equilibrium reference instead describes displacement around force balance. Recommend explicit origin during later content work; no oscillation method or full correctness sweep asserted.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Weight line crossing support edge causes gravity-driven tipping; lower CG/wider base improves usual static margin.
sourceLedger.disposition: CONFIRMED within stated comparable quasi-static model
sourceLedger.source: OpenStax College Physics2e, Stability
sourceLedger.page: 9.3 center of gravity, support base and restoring/overturning comparison
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Publisher relates center relative to support base to restoring/overturning tendency and describes lower CG/wider support increasing stability. Current examples give comparable conditions; no critical-angle, force-system or vehicle-specific safety claim is certified.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Turning vehicle requires acceleration/load-transfer consideration beyond vertical gravity projection.
sourceLedger.disposition: CONFIRMED model boundary; exact vehicle outcome not verified
sourceLedger.source: NHTSA current Car Safety Ratings description
sourceLedger.page: Rollover Resistance Test Scenario / Static Stability Factor
sourceLedger.verificationNote: Opened primary current page. It combines an at-rest top-heaviness measurement with a dynamic driving maneuver rather than treating static measurement as the entire prediction. This corroborates the lesson's boundary; no actual truck outcome, safety rating or driving instruction is inferred.

sourceLedger.originalContent: Gear10*6/30; pulley60*9.8/2 and rope travel; perpendicular lever balance; spring ratios and stiffness.
sourceLedger.disposition: CONFIRMED selected named-model arithmetic; givens are illustrative

topicRecords.summary:
Preserve shareable feature-tracking and consistency checks once, with grouping, matrix, series, rigid-object and unfolding applications kept distinct. DOST explicitly names visualization/rotation/disassembly only in historical 2026 evidence; current 2027 continuity and exact nets/shadows/folding tasks remain unknown. USTET confirms Mental Ability, not its nonverbal composition or fine families. ACET/DCAT/SM spatial/abstract/pattern leads are weak or historically qualified, with fine arrangements/depth and instruction language unconfirmed. Paper Folding's single ACET map lead is not exclusivity. All current teaching/prompts are English; symbolic stimuli do not establish language-free or bilingual delivery.

- Retain Grouping, Matrices, Series and Paper Folding as coherent current goals. Different feature/rule categories alone do not justify separate lessons. Grouping compares member features; matrices combine directional constraints; series checks transitions; unfolding reverses folds with layer/geometry conditions. Shared principle and both-source evidence appear in the appendix; no related-topic prerequisite is inferred.
- Split candidate: rigid rotation/cube-net relationships versus projection models in Mental Rotation (body12-101,L01/L19). Folded-face/handedness invariants and light-source/screen geometry use different methods and conditions. Retain shared 3D terms once, develop an actual paired-view rotation application, and preserve the projection-model qualifiers. Costs: approved identities/routing, moved examples/traps/conditions, source/Math checks and later practice alignment. Unknown fine exam scope does not establish an excluded strand.
- Thin/missing local applications include curved-line/complex shading/competing grouping rules, intersection/cancellation and digit-valued matrices, series position/mark/symmetry/interleaving, paired-view rotation/chirality, exact label orientation, disassembly, and exact cut positions/outlines/partial layers. These are bounded local preparation gaps, not an exhaustive organizer syllabus or corpus-wide absence. No arbitrary example/question minimum is used.
- Series Example4 does not define its complete next-size/candidate system; only white fill is determined. That is an input limitation that could be resolved textually, not a reason to mandate an image. Blob symmetry is intended verbally but no exact contour verification was performed. Most current examples explicitly supply names, directions, counts, row rules, net layouts, folds/layers or light/screen conditions.
- No answer-critical dependency on a displayed figure was established from those source texts. Actual visual inspection, diagram/choice delivery and runtime availability remain unverified. This does not judge illustration need, quality, sufficiency, counts or production, and does not apply the retired blanket figure wording.
- Five explicit no-necessary-existing-prerequisite records are saved. Current rules/conditions are supplied locally. Series references inside Matrices, general Geometry/Physics, exponent methods and future expanded tasks are optional/deeper preparation; no current absent indispensable idea with a necessary existing foundation was established. Input gaps are not lesson prerequisites.
- CSE Professional officially names English Analytical symbolic/abstract reasoning, but the exact figural families here are unconfirmed. Both CSE Numerical areas name number sequence; local count progression is partial transfer, not proof of figural formats. Subprofessional Clerical/Numerical is not Professional Analytical, and no global fine-task exclusion is asserted.
- Ten bounded ledger entries preserve mathematical confirmations and qualification concerns. Cube orientation propagation confirms the specified valid cross and invalid row/stack. Ideal cylinder projections and conditional punch counts are consistent. Paper metadata's even-spacing description is an additional assumption: a valid three-fold punch can give eight symmetric copies with unequal gaps, although a centered special case could be evenly spaced. No rendered-figure error is claimed. The fold-intersection location is fixed, but an arbitrary cut outline need not reflect onto itself. Checklist speed and matrix-family prevalence claims remain unverified. No full correctness or Level5 solve pass is claimed.

Source scope: [accepted requirements](../requirements/), [CET/scholarship overlap](../overlap/cet-scholarship-scope.md#reasoning-families-and-general-information), [CSE scope](../overlap/cse-scope.md). Exact IDs preserve source/cycle/language/cohort confidence; arithmetic/geometric ledger notes re-derive only encountered claims from pinned inputs. Practice, runtime access, Level4 standards/illustrations and Level5 questions remain deferred. Fresh independent review is required.

topicRecords.summary:
- Retain shared introductory chemistry once; no supported exam-specific deletion or excess verdict follows from current unknown depth.
- Split candidate: separate composition-to-formula inference from reaction quantities in stoichiometry. This improves goal focus and a basic-to-extended preparation route, at the cost of a new approved lesson identity, moved examples/traps, and later linked-practice review.
- Reorder candidate: teach Lewis construction before deriving VSEPR groups. Definitions alone cannot supply this foundation (L01/L17/L19). No full Lewis, formal-charge or resonance procedure appears in the 17 chemistry bodies.
- Local gaps: dilution, dynamic chemical equilibrium, Kinetic Molecular Theory, molecular dipole cancellation/intermolecular reasoning, and experimental variable/data interpretation. Their source tiers and exam-depth uncertainties remain explicit.
- Thin applications: branched organic naming, concrete functional-group/property comparisons, simple reaction product mole/mass chains, theoretical yield derived from reactants, and concentration-to-pH use. Periodic-table named families are not explained despite the outline facet (B03/L01 structural use).
- Biomolecule/safety coverage is absent locally. Whole inventory identifies biology and other safety/background search leads; the lead must reconcile other topic findings before any corpus-wide gap claim.
- No load-bearing figure dependencies encountered: all chemistry example prompts supply enough textual givens to be attempted. This is neither an illustration-sufficiency verdict nor runtime verification.
- Prerequisites use existing IDs and both-end evidence only. Missing Lewis/equilibrium foundations have no invented lesson targets. Intralesson ordering is separate. Basic mathematical literacy is assumed; no unsupported arithmetic roadmap edge is asserted.
- Required depth, Science language, cohort exposure, current cycle continuity, student availability and practice remain unresolved. Source checks here are bounded encountered facts, not a Level 4 correctness sweep.

Accepted source packets: [UPCAT](../requirements/upcat.md), [DCAT](../requirements/dcat.md), [ACET](../requirements/acet.md), [USTET](../requirements/ustet.md), [PUPCET](../requirements/pupcet.md), [DOST-SEI](../requirements/dost-sei.md), [SM Foundation](../requirements/sm-foundation.md). topicRecords.summary:
Shared teaching can serve several exams once: Earth spheres, motions/eclipses, rock-cycle processes, plate mechanisms and basic weather distinctions. UPCAT/USTET officially name broad Science only; DOST Earth/Space domains are official for 2026 with 2027 continuity unknown. DCAT/PUPCET finer scope is weak or inferred; ACET/SM Science inclusion is unconfirmed. CSE Professional climate background serves English General Information, not a Science subject. Curriculum and SHS track/cohort/completion limits remain. Bodies are English; other Science item languages, tested depth and student access remain unknown. Practice is deferred Level 5.

- Split candidate: separate regional weather/atmospheric processes from climate mechanism and impacts. The latter needs impact/action teaching, not merely a moved paragraph. Benefit: focused shared climate preparation and environmental decisions. Cost: approved new identity/routing, new applications, moved examples/traps and later practice review. Evidence: weather-and-climate lines 12-35 versus 37-43 and 47-81; cse-professional-L055, ustet-L126.
- Retain the other coherent cores. Combined origin models explicitly contrast cosmic and Solar System scales. Water-reservoir context directly serves hydrology; a thin currents paragraph is not sufficient grounds to split existing teaching. Evidence: origin-of-the-universe lines 12-29, 63-65; water-cycle-oceanography lines 12-30, 56-65.
- Local gaps: seasonal constellations, planet/star comparison and stellar development, tides, breezes/ITCZ, monsoon/cyclone formation mechanisms, Philippine resources/geothermal uses and hazard/impact decisions. Mechanism/classification names do not establish applied coverage. Detailed facet evidence is recorded once below (L01; required depth qualifiers retained).
- Inquiry is partly demonstrated through qualitative geologic, seismic and cosmic evidence. Explicit variable/control identification and direct measured graph/table/map interpretation remain absent or thin locally; this is not a corpus-wide gap claim. References: dcat-L077 and ustet-L113.
- Examples generally stand on textual givens; no load-bearing figure dependence was encountered. The origin diagram prompt describes the misconception in words (lines 35-42). Marker presence supplies no runtime or illustration-sufficiency proof.
- No strictly necessary existing-lesson prerequisite link was found in the completed local readings. Each lesson has an explicit status. Redshift is a local foundation gap with corpus placement unresolved; introductory term/context additions should precede evidence use without invented roadmap targets.
